nodes.description: address public owner; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the access-control anchor in onlyOwner
string public name of the token, set in the MineableToken constructor
string public symbol of the token, set in the MineableToken constructor
uint8 public decimals, set in the MineableToken constructor
uint256 public totalSupply; increased by mine() and decreased by burn()/burnFrom()
mapping(address => uint256) balances_; core balance ledger updated by mine, _transfer, burn and burnFrom
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowances_; approval ledger updated by approve, transferFrom, burnFrom
caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, allowance keys, balance keys and callback arguments
external call to tokenRecipient(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, value, context) inside approveAndCall, executed after the allowance state change
low-level address(rx).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(custom_fallback, msg.sender, value, data)) in the 4-argument transfer; arbitrary external function selector supplied by caller
external call to ContractReceiver(to).tokenFallback(msg.sender, value, data) inside transferToContract after balances were updated
inline assembly block reading extcodesize(_addr) inside isContract to decide whether a recipient is a contract
owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender
changeOwner(address _miner) public onlyOwner: reassigns the owner state variable
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner), guards changeOwner and mine
mine(uint256 qty, address receiver) public onlyOwner: mints qty to receiver and grows totalSupply
ERC20 view returning balances_[owner]
ERC20 approve(address spender, uint256 value): writes allowances_[msg.sender][spender] = value
safeApprove(address _spender, uint256 _currentValue, uint256 _value): only overwrites when the stored allowance matches _currentValue
ERC20 view returning allowances_[owner][spender]
ERC20 transfer(address to, uint256 value): delegates to _transfer(msg.sender, to, value, empty)
ERC20 transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): checks and decrements allowance then calls _transfer
Ethereum-Token approveAndCall(address spender, uint256 value, bytes context): approves then performs an untrusted external receiveApproval callback
burn(uint256 value): destroys caller balance and reduces totalSupply
burnFrom(address from, uint256 value): destroys from's balance using the caller's allowance and reduces totalSupply
ERC223 transfer(address to, uint value, bytes data, string custom_fallback): transfers then performs an arbitrary low-level call on the recipient
ERC223 transfer(address to, uint value, bytes data): routes to transferToContract when the recipient is a contract
private transferToContract(address to, uint value, bytes data): transfers then invokes tokenFallback on the recipient contract
private view isContract(address _addr): returns extcodesize(_addr) > 0
internal _transfer(address from, address to, uint value, bytes data): validates, moves balances and emits Transfer
MineableToken constructor(uint8 _decimals, string _name, string _symbol): initializes metadata and totalSupply = 0
receive() external payable: always reverts, the contract refuses plain ETH
fallback() external payable: always reverts on unmatched calldata
